mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM track_comments WHERE id = #{commentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT tc.id AS id, tc.user_id, u.name, tc.content, DATE_FORMAT(tc.created_at, '%Y년%m월%d일, %H시%i분') AS created_at, -- 이미지들 tci.original_filename, tci.stored_filename FROM track_comments tc JOIN users u ON tc.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN track_comment_images tci ON tc.id = tci.comment_id WHERE tc.track_id = #{trackId} AND tc.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO track_comments (user_id, track_id, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{trackId}, #{content})

INSERT INTO track_comment_images (comment_id, original_filename, stored_filename) VALUES
(#{id}, #{image.originalFilename}, #{image.storedFilename})
mapper.update: UPDATE track_comments SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
